review_warning: Unclear state definitions make oscillatory behavior uninterpretable

formal_role: Represents the first derivative of the state variable
systems_modeling_role: Captures movement momentum or adjustment speed
review_warning: Second-order models require both state and rate initial conditions

systems_modeling_role: Models friction dissipation adjustment cost or institutional resistance
review_warning: Damping may not be linear or constant in real systems

systems_modeling_role: Models stiffness correction pressure target seeking or feedback
review_warning: Linear restoring force may fail far from equilibrium

formal_role: Represents external input shock or periodic driver
systems_modeling_role: Models demand policy environment load or intervention
review_warning: Forcing should be measured estimated or clearly labeled as scenario input

formal_role: Defines how the second-order equation is approximated as a first-order system
systems_modeling_role: Supports reproducible simulation and solver review
review_warning: Oscillatory systems are sensitive to step size and solver choice
